camel_example: aliyun gpdb DescribeWaitingSQLRecords --region cn-hangzhou --Order '{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}' --User testUser --PageSize 30 --EndTime '2022-08-20T07:59Z' --Keyword table --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2022-08-15T06:59Z' --Database test --QueryCondition '{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}'
description_en: Queries the lock diagnostic records of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例锁诊断列表
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-waiting-sql-records --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --start-time 2022-08-15T06:59Z --end-time 2022-08-20T07:59Z --user testUser --database test --query-condition '{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}' --keyword table --order '{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWaitingSQLRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值说明：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If this parameter is not specified, all lock diagnostics records that are generated before the query end time are returned. If the query end time is not specified either, all lock diagnostics records are returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 不填则表示没有查询开始时间，将返回查询结束时间之前所有锁诊断信息。如果也没有查询结束时间，将返回全部锁诊断信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

If this parameter is not specified, all lock diagnostics records that are generated after the query start time are returned. If the query start time is not specified either, all lock diagnostics records are returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 不填则表示没有查询结束时间，将返回查询开始时间之后所有锁诊断信息。如果也没有查询开始时间，将返回全部锁诊断信息
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account. If this parameter is not specified, the lock diagnostics records of all database accounts are queried
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。不填则表示查询所有用户的锁等待信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition on queries. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}`: filters the top 10 longest-waiting queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"LockWaiting"}`: filters lock-waiting queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"ResourceWaiting"}`: filters resource-waiting queries
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}`：等待时间最长的10个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"LockWaiting"}`：锁等待的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"ResourceWaiting"}`：资源等待的查询
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter queries
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort lock diagnostics records and the sorting order.

Default value: `{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`, which indicates that lock diagnostics records are sorted by the start time in descending order. No other values are supported
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段和排序方式。

默认为`{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`，表示按开始时间进行排序。暂不支持其他排序字段和排序方式
parameters.name: order
